## As it is actually written

Cut from **Brand** in the `contoso5` bundle — not typed by hand.

```yaml
- id: brand.resolution.by_grouping_products
  subject: Brand
  kind: mac.concept.rule.resolution
  confidence: P
  scope: CONTOSO5
  binds:
  - brand
  when: the set of products carrying one brand is needed
  then: 'group dim_product on `brand`. The relation is computed — there is no brand table
    and no brand key, so the instance set IS the distinct names on the product row.

    '
  never: 'join to a brand relation

    '
  why: 'none exists, and inventing one gives eleven names a surrogate the warehouse does
    not have

    '
- id: brand.exclusion.is_not_manufacturer
  subject: Brand
  kind: mac.concept.rule.exclusion
  confidence: P
  scope: CONTOSO5
  binds:
  - brand
  when: a question asks who is behind a product
  then: decide whether it means the brand the customer buys or the manufacturer, and say
    which
  never: treat the two columns as interchangeable because their member sets overlap
```
